goals: Preserve the accepted Minecraft Java 26.2 compatibility contract between Inventory Extended 1.1.2 and Trinkets Updated 4.1.0-beta.3+26.2 without adding new behavior to either upstream mod.
Retain the exact three-artifact Canary 5 set that reconciles startup validation, expanded creative mapping, quick-move boundaries, and the proven Trinkets charm-icon mismatch.
scope: Remove only Inventory Extended's competing FixCreativeSlotRangeCheck mixin declaration while retaining its 1.1.2 identity and all other archive entries.
Patch Trinkets' Creative-to-Survival wrapper bound to the live Trinkets slot start and derive both ordinary-player quick-move ends from the live non-equipment inventory size.
Retain the companion's exclusive live-menu creative packet guard and its narrow trinkets:gui/slots/charm to trinkets:container/slots/charm icon translation.

Preserve the accepted C5 runtime evidence for all six Inventory Extended rows, physical hotbar and offhand boundaries, Trinkets equip and unequip, creative wrappers, persistence, and the configured keepInventory path.

exclusions: New Inventory Extended or Trinkets features, ports, redesigns, upstream replacements, or compatibility behavior beyond the frozen C5 contract.

Matcha Flavoured resource-pack artwork and inventory composition, Inventory 3×3 Crafting, Offhand Shift-Click, Carried Container Auto-Routing, Quick Stack, and every other inventory compatibility layer remain independently owned.

The completed temporary visual diagnostic, its JAR and trace tooling, the aborted non-representative localhost server harness, obsolete canaries, legacy audits, status narratives, historical matrices, and global project databases.
Hosted-server join, relog, and dimension validation and keepInventory-disabled death drops remain untested and are not inferred from the accepted client evidence.
Minecraft deployment, Test Slot changes, accepted-stack mutation, promotion, Test Instance Manager changes, Minecraft launch, and access to either physical gameplay profile during this migration.
